summary: Product Reviews Feature Testing Complete - All backend APIs working, frontend UI verified. Fixed critical bug in company login endpoint.

fixed.issue: AttributeError: 'CompanyLoginInput' object has no attribute 'rccm_number' - audit log was referencing old field

context_for_next_testing_agent: Product reviews feature fully working. Company login now uses phone_number instead of RCCM. Frontend ProductDetail.js shows reviews section with login prompt for non-logged users and review form for logged-in customers.

bug_fixed.description: Company login endpoint was throwing 500 Internal Server Error
bug_fixed.root_cause: In the audit log for successful company login, the code referenced input_data.rccm_number but CompanyLoginInput model only has phone_number and password fields (RCCM was removed when login was changed to use phone number)
bug_fixed.fix_applied: Changed line 1698 in server.py from 'rccm': input_data.rccm_number to 'phone': input_data.phone_number
bug_fixed.verification: Company login now works correctly with phone number
